actions.description: The existing knowledge-base node stands; the new insight is recorded and linked to it. If the node is an accepted project document, the conflicting note is corrected instead
The new insight replaces the existing knowledge-base node, which is marked superseded and not deleted. Never available against an accepted project document
The conflict is not decidable from the evidence; it is held for the Project Owner (a possible defect in a project document then goes through the baseline feedback route)
